explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/368: 'How large is the largest prime factor of n(n+1)? … The truth is probably F(n) ≫ (log n)² for all n.' In Lean F n = maxPrimeFac (n(n+1)) (tests: F 8 = 3, F 80 = 5, F 4374 = 7), and the statement is ∃ c > 0, ∀ n ≥ 1, c·(log n)² ≤ F n. This is the page's conjectured truth, stated uniformly for all n ≥ 1 as on the page. Faithful.
